title: CI: Fix `make_rst.py` typo
body:
- Follow-up to #124752

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Fixes a typo that caused the wrong `set` function to be called. `remove()` was used when `discard()` was intended, as the former raises a KeyError while the latter does not
